correctness.rationale: Exact finite chain enumeration exhausts all four automorphism orbits covering all 256 endpoint pairs. Signed boundary matrices satisfy d3*d4=0; d4 integer Smith factors are all 1, so H3 is free with ranks 0,0,1,1. Cocycle transformations modulo integral rationalized coboundaries give both full stabilizer sign tables. The independently documented group order 192 proves affine group completeness; induced modules and invariant/coinvariant consequences follow. value.rationale: The full integral automorphism module is a natural invariant in the precise first off-diagonal bidegree already used to distinguish two canonical strongly regular graphs. Torsion-freeness is a genuine strengthening beyond known rational ranks, and nontrivial signs of both distance-two stabilizers imply vanishing full-group invariants and order-two coinvariants, distinguishing the module from an unsigned permutation action. This is structurally motivated by graph symmetries, not arbitrary finite enumeration.
